item.title: BPT Logic Map
item.description:
Home | ← Back

The Navigation Map

The BPT Navigation Map is the conceptual blueprint of your good EA Navigator. Navigating the whole organization,

The Three Segments

  1. B (Business): The Captain’s decision layer. Owners of the investment.
  2. P (Product): The Business Analyst layer. Owners of the functional logic.
  3. T (Technology): The Implementation layer. Navigating around Legacy Icebergs. Deploying the products.

The Stake Holders View

The Organization Navigator (Enterprise Architect) uses this as a map to ensure that the “Technology Pistons” are capable of delivering the “Business Intent” without hitting hidden risks. And forever de risking the Depths of the Technical Debt.

item.title: DBJ CMM Protocol
item.description:
Home | ← Back

Ensuring Sea-Worthiness

DBJ CMM Protocol

The DBJ CMM is the organizational enablement required to start the endless business flow. You certify your crew at Levels 3 to 5.

Assessment Tiers

  • Level 3 (Defined): Standardized daily workflows; no reliance on individual heroics.
  • Level 4 (Managed): The EA Navigator monitors the engine with objective metrics.
  • Level 5 (Optimizing): Continuous improvement; the ship is fully AI-Enabled.

Note: A “Legacy Business Ship” cannot take AI cargo into production without reaching these maturity levels.

item.title: DBJ Taxonomy Ledger
item.description:
Home | ← Back

DBJ Taxonomy: The Language of the Crew

In the cold of a market storm, miscommunication is a shipwreck. The DBJ Taxonomy provides a standardized language base for the whole crew.

Core Inventory

  • Business Lexicon: Standardizing terms for ROI, Investability, and Strategic Intent.
  • Product Logic: Defining the functional requirements used by the Business Analyst (P).
  • Technology Assets: Precise classification of Legacy systems and AI components.

Value to the Captain

Eliminates the “Doubt” of interpretation. When a command is issued, the Engine Room (Technology) and the Bridge (Business) share the exact same definition of success.

item.title: The DBJ ADM Steering Guide
item.description:
Home | ← Back

The Business Ship Steering Wheel

The DBJ ADM is a simplified version of the full TOGAF ADM adapted for business users of the DBJ Method. It retains the wheel metaphor — a repeating cycle of governed architecture work — while reducing the step count to what a real organization can sustain.

The DBJ ADM wheel produces distilled architecture artifacts. The wheel authorizes delivery; it never delivers. {: .note}
